task: Implement the /login screen (SAA 2025) with Google OAuth against the local Supabase stack, per MoMorph screen GzbNeVGJHz.
acceptanceCriteria: FR-201: /login renders header (logo left, VN selector right), hero, ROOT FURTHER wordmark, subtitle, tagline, Google button and fixed footer
FR-202: login button shows disabled + loading state while authentication is in flight, and a shadow on hover
FR-203: language selector defaults to VN, opens on click, and switches page copy to the chosen locale
FR-401: successful Google authentication returns the user and redirects to /todo
FR-402: failed or cancelled authentication shows 'Dang nhap khong thanh cong. Vui long thu lai.'
FR-101: unauthenticated access to /todo redirects to /login
FR-102: authenticated access to /login redirects to /todo
FR-601: any valid Google account may sign in, with no domain allow-list
BR-003: an invalid NEXT_LOCALE value falls back to VN without a blank page
Rotated Supabase auth cookies survive the guarded redirect (single-use refresh tokens must not be dropped)
The OAuth callback never redirects a user off this origin
blastRadius: proxy.ts runs on every non-asset request, so a fault there affects the whole app, not just /login. It now performs route protection in addition to session refresh. Supabase refresh tokens are single-use, so dropping rotated cookies on a redirect would log users out app-wide one request later. supabase/config.toml gained an [auth.external.google] block, which the CLI validates at stack start; a malformed block can stop the local stack from booting. lib/supabase/* was deliberately left untouched.
contracts: Frozen cross-track integration contract in plan.md: resolveLocale, getDictionary, signInWithGoogle, setLocale, signOut signatures plus a closed dictionary-key list
Supabase OAuth redirect allow-list: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL must match site_url and additional_redirect_urls exactly
@supabase/ssr cookie contract: cookie names and chunking are owned by the library, never hand-built
